lesson: All 5 losses occurred by shorting into extreme oversold RSI conditions during a persistent markdown phase, indicating a failure to identify Wyckoffian 'Springs' or local accumulation. The system is incorrectly prioritizing trend-following momentum over mean reversion signals when the asset is already at local lows.
adjustment: Implement a mandatory 'No-Short' filter when the 1h RSI drops below 30, requiring a confirmed retest of the EMA50 as resistance before entering any new short positions.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI oversold signals MORE for counter-trend entries and trend-following momentum LESS during local exhaustion.
